newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's king speaks to Arafat, Netanyahu by phone.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's king speaks to Arafat, Netanyahu by phone.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein spoke by telephone on Friday with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Natanyahu to help advance the peace process, state television reported.
The monarch spoke with the two leaders after the Israeli cabinet's decision on Friday on a limited pullback from the West Bank, the television said.
It said the king expressed support for the Palestinain Authority's efforts to advance the peace process but did not give other details about the telephone conversations.

Prime Minister Abdul Karim al-Kabariti will carry a letter from King Hussein for Arafat when he travels to Palestinian self-ruled Gaza on Saturday on a scheduled visit to take part in a joint committee to bolster ties, the television said.
Jordan, with a large Palestinian population, is concerned that lack of significant progress in implementing peace accords could plunge the region back into violence.
